methodology.observed: Counts come from course catalog exports and installed public/library manifests/provenance. A work is installed only when it has a published provenance entry; catalogue recommendations and empty stage slots are reported as planning signals, not proven CEFR gaps.
methodology.publishedOnly: Installed text and word totals are taken from published provenance entries. Scripture and secular/heritage classes are separated in publishedByClass; generated unreviewed drafts are counted separately and never inflate installed coverage.
methodology.classification: Scripture is separated from secular reading. Heritage means an installed public-domain or scan-backed source; modern-source-authored and modern-standard-or-unreviewed works remain separate.
methodology.limitations: Word and sentence metrics are source-level approximations and may include front matter or document segmentation artifacts. They are not CEFR measurements or native-speaker review. Thai word counts require adapter tokenization; Latin-script and Devanagari word counts use Unicode-letter approximations.
